google_play.full_description:
3D Raycaster — Official Arcade Mobile Edition 🕶️

Navigate 3D mazes rendered with raycasting projection & trigonometry.

🎮 KEY GAMEPLAY FEATURES:
• Procedurally Generated Levels & Dynamic Challenges
• 100% Mobile Optimized — Virtual Joysticks, Touch Controls & On-Screen Keyboards
• Educational Computer Science Concepts (3D Graphics): Raycasting & 3D Projection — how Wolfenstein 3D used 2D maps and angle rays to compute distance and draw pseudo-3D walls.
• Offline Playable — Zero internet required, zero ads, zero tracking
• High score tracking, instant restart, and slick retro-futuristic sound effects

📱 CONTROLS:
Use touch direction controls or WASD / Arrow keys to move and turn.

Play right now on your mobile phone or tablet!
